name: ampersand-bridge-copilot-chat
displayName: Ampersand Bridge for GitHub Copilot Chat
description: Use ai& models in GitHub Copilot Chat with your own API key. Independent extension, not affiliated with ai&.

commands.title: Ampersand Bridge: Set Inline Suggestions Model
Ampersand Bridge: Show Usage and Credits
Ampersand Bridge: Select Inline Suggestions Entry

ampersandBridge.inlineSuggestions.description: Experimental. Provide ghost-text inline completions while typing, powered by the ai& service with fill-in-the-middle prompting. Credentials, prompts, and document context are never logged.

ampersandBridge.inlineSuggestionsModel.description: Model id used for inline completions. deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4-flash is the measured low-latency default; the Set Inline Suggestions Model command lists vetted candidates with measured latency badges.

ampersandBridge.inlineSuggestionsChatInp.description: Also offer inline completions inside the Copilot Chat prompt box.

ampersandBridge.inlineSuggestionsDebounc.description: Debounce window in milliseconds between typing and an inline completion request.

ampersandBridge.inlineSuggestionsTimeout.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds for inline completions.

ampersandBridge.inlineSuggestionsMaxToke.description: Maximum tokens generated per inline completion.

ampersandBridge.inlineSuggestionsPrefixL.description: Lines of document context sent before the cursor.

ampersandBridge.inlineSuggestionsSuffixC.description: Characters of document context sent after the cursor.

enumDescriptions: Disable reasoning for the fastest response.
Use less reasoning for lower latency and cost.
Balance reasoning depth, latency, and cost.
Use deeper reasoning for complex tasks.
Use extra-high reasoning for especially difficult tasks.
Use the model's maximum reasoning effort.
ampersandBridge.reasoningEffort.description: Default Ampersand Bridge reasoning effort. A Copilot model-picker selection overrides this value, and a model only accepts efforts from its own supported list.

ampersandBridge.maxOutputTokens.description: Maximum output tokens requested from Ampersand Bridge. Use 0 to reserve up to 32,768 response tokens. Positive values are capped by the model output capability and context window.

ampersandBridge.requestTimeoutSeconds.description: Maximum duration of an Ampersand Bridge inference request in seconds.

ampersandBridge.streamIdleTimeoutSeconds.description: Maximum time without receiving streamed Ampersand Bridge response data before aborting a request.

ampersandBridge.catalogCacheMinutes.description: How long the Ampersand Bridge model catalog is reused before refreshing.

ampersandBridge.debugLogging.description: Log request, stream, usage, and model-discovery metadata to the Ampersand Bridge output channel. Prompts and API keys are never logged.

ampersandBridge.showUsageStatusBar.description: Show Ampersand Bridge credit balance and usage in the status bar. Click to open the usage quick pick.

ampersandBridge.managementEntry.description: Explicit native entryId used for models, usage, and connection tests. Select an available entry through Ampersand Bridge: Manage Connection. No automatic fallback.

ampersandBridge.inlineSuggestionsEntry.description: Explicit native entryId used for inline suggestions. Select an available entry through Ampersand Bridge: Manage Connection. No automatic fallback.

apiKey.title: Ampersand Bridge API Key
apiKey.description: API key for this Ampersand Bridge provider entry. VS Code stores configured secrets securely.

entryId.title: Unique Entry ID
entryId.description: Unique stable ID for this entry, such as personal or work. Keep it when rotating the key. Native group names are display labels and do not identify credentials.
